description: Generate a new EVM or SOL wallet and store its private key in the OS keychain. Only the address is returned; the private key is never printed and never leaves the CLI process. The wallet is not tradeable until wallet_register and wallet_add_key run. To use an existing wallet instead, ask the user to run `orderly-trading-mcp setup` in a terminal.

network.description: Network override for this call. Defaults to ORDERLY_MCP_NETWORK, then the CLI config.

type.description: Wallet type: EVM or SOL (required in non-interactive mode) One of: EVM, SOL.

name: wallet_create
title: Create a wallet (onboarding step 1)
